article.title: Static compressibility of magnesite to 20 GPa: Implications for MgCO3 in the lower mantle

primary_data.transcription: Pressure, a, c, V, and all printed parenthetical uncertainties were checked against a rendered image of Table 1. No plotted points were digitized.

pressure_calibration.finding: The Experimental Methods state that pressure was calculated from the least-squares-refined cell volume of internal NaCl using the Decker EOS. Table 1 omits the row-wise NaCl volumes.

fixed_kp.objective: Unweighted pressure residuals, implementing the source's unspecified least-squares reduced Birch fit.

free_kp.selection: The nine Table 1 rows satisfying the source's fV>0.01 criterion.
free_kp.objective: Volume residuals weighted by the printed one-sigma volume uncertainties.
free_kp.qualification: The fitted coefficients are consistent with the published fit, but K0_prime is weakly constrained (refit one-sigma uncertainty 1.345) and the source reports no K0_prime uncertainty, so strict uncertainty parity cannot be established.

remaining_limit: The paper does not publish the precise numerical implementation of its weighting, parameter covariance, or row-wise NaCl observations. These limits do not prevent direct reproduction from the published sample P-V table.
conclusion: Both records are directly refittable from authoritative Table 1 data; digitization is unnecessary.
